## Overview
Sujith Putta is a Generative AI Developer, Full-Stack Systems Architect, and Product Builder based in Bengaluru, India. He specializes in Sovereign RAG pipelines, FastAPI microservices, deterministic Rust safety gates, and cloud-native systems on Azure & AWS. He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Technology at Dayananda Sagar University (CGPA 9.05).
